opportunity.title: The Opportunity
opportunity.body: Côte d'Ivoire is the world's largest cashew producer — over 1.2 million metric tons annually — yet less than 15% is processed locally. Billions in value leave the country every year as raw nuts are shipped to Asia for processing. The Ivorian government is now actively incentivizing domestic processors to close this gap. AfriNuts is positioned to be the first certified processor in northwestern Côte d'Ivoire.

exitStrategy.title: Exit Strategy & Investor Protections
exitStrategy.subtitle: Clear paths to liquidity with robust shareholder protections

options.title: Company Sale / Merger / IPO
options.description: In the event of an Exit, the Investor receives 25% of net proceeds distributed to shareholders, proportionate to their equity ownership.

options.title: Drag-Along Rights
options.description: If majority shareholders approve a sale, the Investor agrees to sell on the same terms — ensuring a clean, unified exit for all parties.

options.title: Tag-Along Rights
options.description: If a founder or majority shareholder sells their shares, the Investor may join the transaction and sell a proportionate amount on the same terms — protecting against being left with illiquid shares.

options.title: Mutual Buyout Option (2031)
options.description: Either party may trigger a buyout. Valuation based on: 2× original investment, 5× gross revenue, or independent appraisal. Deferred payments allowed — no riba, no coercion.

exitStrategy.liquidation: In the event of force majeure or business failure, Investor receives a share of remaining assets after debts — proportionate to their equity ownership.

farmOs.title: Farm OS: The Technology Behind the Investment
farmOs.body: Most agribusiness investments rely on trust and quarterly PDFs. Ours runs on a custom-built operating system that gives investors real-time visibility into farm performance — trees alive, expenses per block, harvest volumes, and profit projections. The same dashboard our team uses daily is available to verified investors.
capabilities: Block-level financial tracking — revenue and expenses per hectare
Real-time dashboard with KPIs, charts, and photo documentation
Task management and worker performance analytics
Batch traceability from harvest to export container
